raw_html: [[Entangling Yarn#Legendary Entangling Yarn|Legendary Entangling Yarn]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Entangling Yarn#Legendary Entangling Yarn|Legendary Entangling Yarn]]:''' Enemies struck by this weapon have a small chance to be tangled up in its enchanted yarn, becoming [[Entangled]] and preventing all movement for 9 seconds. A DC 110 Reflex Save negates this effect.
